description_en: Queries the list of Agents and usage summary information under the current username
description_zh: 查询当前用户名下的Agent列表及用量汇总信息
kebab_example: aliyun wss describe-credit-package-agents --biz-type BUSINESS --agent-type JVS_COPILOT --agent-ids jvs-xxxx --max-results 100 --next-token eyJvZmZzZXQiOjIwfQ== --region cn-hangzhou
name: DescribeCreditPackageAgents

parameters.help_en: The Agent type. Valid values: `CREDIT_PACKAGE`, `JVS_CLAW`, `OPEN_CLAW`, and `JVS_COPILOT`
parameters.name: agent_type

parameters.help_en: A JSON string of the AgentId list. Example: `["agent-1","agent-2"]`
parameters.help_zh: AgentId 列表的 JSON 字符串，例：`["agent-1","agent-2"]`
parameters.name: agent_ids

parameters.help_en: The number of entries per page
parameters.name: max_results

parameters.help_en: The pagination token. Set this parameter to an empty string for the first request. For subsequent requests, use the `nextToken` value from the previous response
parameters.help_zh: 分页 Token；首次请求传空，后续取上一次响应的 `nextToken`
parameters.name: next_token
